searchText: glad I compromised some security for less fees on polygon 😆 just joking of course, but Polygon handled it well, so curious if its just a sidechain why does it perform with such high tps, its just a copy of Eth what makes it so much faster? is it just larger block size like BSC? https://twitter.com/PaoloRebuffo/status/1395024889749417990 I'd expect that in runs like these ones tips are going to be huge anyway so little (if anything) should change... We'll know in a few months If there are faster computers and they all have faster internet, most easily achieved by having fewer nodes, then they can send blocks between themselves faster. The chance that a chain splits or miners are (accidentally) working on an uncle block depends on the blocktime and the latency. If someone else has found the next block and you don't see their message, then you're still working on the old one. If all your nodes are near each other (centralised) then propagation times will be lower. Larger blocksizie like BSC slows down the blocktime, since there's more data to transmit and process (taking longer). Is Vlad Zamfir still active in the ETH scene?

excerpts.author: 3xmd1559sporebraytondingo
excerpts.content:
If there are faster computers and they all have faster internet, most easily achieved by having fewer nodes, then they can send blocks between themselves faster. The chance that a chain splits or miners are (accidentally) working on an uncle block depends on the blocktime and the latency. If someone else has found the next block and you don't see their message, then you're still working on the old one. If all your nodes are near each other (centralised) then propagation times will be lower. 

Larger blocksizie like BSC slows down the blocktime, since there's more data to transmit and process (taking longer).
